User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user profile in NexusUtils.

uid.description: The unique Firebase UID of the user.

photoURL.description: URL to the user's profile picture.

createdAt.description: When the user account was created.

premiumTier.description: Whether the user is in the premium tier.

Feedback.title: Feedback
Feedback.description: User suggestions, issue reports, or general feedback.

userId.description: The UID of the user who submitted feedback (or null if anonymous).

userEmail.description: Email address of the feedback submitter.

subject.description: Brief summary of the feedback topic.

users/{userId}.description: Holds the profile database record of users, locked to the authentic owners.

feedback/{feedbackId}.description: User feedback reports, submission-only for authenticated/unauthenticated users; read-only for admins.
